selection_protocol: Frozen LLM proposals generated from geometry, material, boundary conditions, load, QoI and refinement budget only; no stress contour, element indicator or oracle ranking was shown.

tip_displacement.definition: Mean z-displacement of the eccentric free-end load patch.

proposals.rationale: The global compliance-like displacement should be sensitive to the high-curvature bending/torsion transfer zone between the clamp and the through-hole, so refine these coupled regions together rather than ranking isolated elements.
The clamp carries the largest bending moment and a substantial torsional reaction, so a compact root volume is a lower-cost candidate when the refinement budget is tight.
The eccentric nodal load introduces local traction discretization error and torsional transfer on the positive-y side, so retain a lower-confidence load-path candidate instead of discarding it.

hole_opening.definition: Mean upper-hole z-displacement minus mean lower-hole z-displacement.

proposals.rationale: The QoI is defined directly on opposite arcs of the through-hole, so the first candidate concentrates resolution around the hole and its two vertical ligaments.

Hole deformation is driven by the local concentration plus the bending/torsion field supplied from the clamp, so a second candidate couples the hole neighborhood with the short upstream transfer zone.
Because the end load is eccentric in y, retain a lower-confidence asymmetric corridor from the hole toward the positive-y load side to test whether torsional coupling matters for this local QoI.
